limitations: The wave legs use a superellipse idealisation of each midship section, rigidly submerged below the free surface. Real hull sections intersect the free surface; the section results are shape hydrodynamics, not ship RAOs, and no seakeeping prediction is claimed.

Series 60 and KVLCC2 are idealised parametric hulls built by tensorbem.pc6_hull calibrated to the published Cb (and, for KVLCC2, the published Lpp/B/T); they are not the official offset tables, so the geometry-fidelity error is unknown rather than zero.

The KK damping direction is band-limited: the truncated high-frequency band enters as an additive constant in B and is reported separately. The gate is applied to the frequency-dependent part; the raw number is reported as well.

Constant-panel collocation with the finite-depth kernel converges slowly on boxy sections (the source density is weakly singular at the bilge). The refinement leg measures the residual at the working mesh instead of assuming it.

All comparisons are against analytic or independent numerical references. No experimental data set ships with this repository, so the evidence level for the absolute engineering magnitudes remains WITHHELD.
